{{Top|leg}}
A '''locator ring''' was a type of [[Locator/Legends|locator]] device that could be worn on a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid's]] finger. The [[Ring/Legends|rings]] were sometimes utilized by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Imperial Sector Police]] to keep track of suspects.
